DigimonCreature.title: DigimonCreature
DigimonCreature.description: An individual Digimon partner raised and trained by a user, with real-time health, stamina, hunger, and evolution progress telemetry.

nickname.description: Custom nickname of the Digimon partner.

speciesId.description: Identifier for the current Digimon species form (e.g., agumon, greymon, wargreymon, omegamon_x).

speciesName.description: Display name of the current Digimon species.

health.description: Real-time health integrity level from 0 to 100.

stamina.description: Real-time stamina energy core level from 0 to 100.

hunger.description: Real-time satiety/fullness level from 0 to 100 (100 = full, 0 = starving).

evolutionProgress.description: Digivolution sync progress percentage from 0 to 100.

bondLevel.description: Tamer bond sync level from 0 to 100.

careMistakes.description: Accumulated care mistakes affecting branching evolution.

isResting.description: Whether the creature is currently in accelerated rest/recovery mode.

unlockedForms.description: Bounded list of speciesIds unlocked in this creature's lineage (max 15).

lastUpdatedMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last real-time stat synchronization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when creature was hatched. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when creature state was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TrainingLogEntry.title: TrainingLogEntry
TrainingLogEntry.description: A chronological daily training or care log entry recorded for a trainer's Digimon.

creatureId.description: Document ID of the Digimon creature.

creatureName.description: Name of the Digimon at the time of training.

activityType.description: Category of the training or care event.

grade.description: Performance rating of the drill or action.

statDeltaSummary.description: Human-readable telemetry delta summary (e.g., '+12 ATK, +15% EVO, -15 STA').

xpGained.description: Combat power / XP earned from the session.

dateKey.description: ISO date key YYYY-MM-DD for daily grouping.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log entry was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PetNotification.title: PetNotification
PetNotification.description: A real-time status alert generated for a trainer's Digimon (hunger, stamina, health, evolution, or trade).

creatureId.description: Document ID of the associated creature.

message.description: Detailed status message and recommended care action.

isRead.description: Whether the trainer has acknowledged this notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was last updated.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public trainer ranking record for global social leaderboard competition.

userId.description: UID of the trainer (matches document ID).

leagueId.description: League partition key for scoped leaderboard queries.

trainerName.description: Public callsign of the Tamer (no PII).

partnerStage.description: Evolution stage of the lead Digimon.

evolutionsUnlocked.description: Total number of Digivolution forms unlocked.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when leaderboard entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when leaderboard entry was last updated.

TradeListing.title: TradeListing
TradeListing.description: Real-time player-to-player monster trade listing on the Global Holo-Trade Exchange.

creatorUserId.description: UID of the trainer who posted the monster for trade.

creatorTrainerName.description: Public callsign of the offering trainer.

offeredCreatureId.description: Original creature ID offered by the creator.

offeredSpeciesId.description: Species ID of the offered monster.

offeredSpeciesName.description: Species display name of the offered monster.

offeredStage.description: Evolution stage of the offered monster.

offeredAttack.description: Attack stat of the offered monster.

offeredDefense.description: Defense stat of the offered monster.

offeredSpeed.description: Speed stat of the offered monster.

offeredWisdom.description: Wisdom stat of the offered monster.

offeredBondLevel.description: Bond level of the offered monster.

requestedStageOrSpecies.description: Requested stage or species preference from trade partner.

accepterUserId.description: UID of the real player who accepted the trade (empty while OPEN).

accepterTrainerName.description: Public callsign of the accepting player.

tradedInNickname.description: Nickname of the monster traded in by the accepting player.

tradedInSpeciesId.description: Species ID of the monster traded in by the accepting player.

tradedInSpeciesName.description: Species display name of the monster traded in.

tradedInStage.description: Stage of the monster traded in.

tradedInAttribute.description: Attribute of the monster traded in.

tradedInLevel.description: Level (1-100) of the monster traded in.

tradedInAttack.description: Attack stat of the monster traded in.

tradedInDefense.description: Defense stat of the monster traded in.

tradedInSpeed.description: Speed stat of the monster traded in.

tradedInWisdom.description: Wisdom stat of the monster traded in.

tradedInBondLevel.description: Bond level of the monster traded in.

claimedByCreator.description: Whether the original creator has received the traded-in monster.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when trade listing was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when trade listing was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Real-time chat message sent by a trainer in the Global Tamer Chat or a Direct Friend Chat.

senderPartnerName.description: Active Digimon partner name of the sender.

senderPartnerStage.description: Stage of the sender's active partner.

recipientUserId.description: UID of the direct message recipient (empty string for global chat).

messageText.description: Chat message text content (1 to 300 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat message was sent.

FriendConnection.title: FriendConnection
FriendConnection.description: Friend request or accepted friendship between two real-life players.

requesterUserId.description: UID of the player who sent the friend request.

requesterPartnerName.description: Lead Digimon partner of the requester.

recipientUserId.description: UID of the player who received the friend request.

recipientPartnerName.description: Lead Digimon partner of the recipient.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the friend request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the friend request was last updated.

/users/{userId}/creatures/{creatureId}.description: User-scoped Digimon squad creatures and real-time telemetry.

/users/{userId}/trainingLogs/{logId}.description: User-scoped daily training and care history logs.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global social leaderboard rankings indexed by trainer UID.

/tradeListings/{tradeId}.description: Global real-time player-to-player monster trade listings.

/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: Real-time global and friend direct chat messages.

/friendships/{friendshipId}.description: Player-to-player friend requests and accepted friendships.
